title: Uppsala police officer convicted of data intrusion over searches in police systems, unt.se reports
date_note: The unt.se page gives only its own publication day, 24 November 2026; it does not give the verdict date.
summary: Local newspaper unt.se reports that a female police officer in Uppsala was convicted of data intrusion (dataintrång). The article says she searched Polisen's internal systems for a private individual and then leaked information; the police security department flagged the searches in March. According to the prosecutor, she made searches on 60 occasions over two years. The article gives no sentence.
plain: Local newspaper unt.se reports a police officer in Uppsala was convicted of data intrusion for searching police systems on behalf of a private person. The article gives no sentence.
exec: Per unt.se, an Uppsala police officer was convicted of misusing access to internal police systems; the article states no sentence.

validation.note: Only unt.se read. Its headline says 64 cases; the body gives the prosecutor's 60 occasions and does not explain 64.

evidence.quote: Enligt åklagaren gjorde poliskvinnan närmare 200 sökningar vid 60 olika tillfällen under en tvåårsperiod.
